## P4 contract reality / pending Owner decision — 2026-10-05

Main remains `c79659046cf6ea73ba69e03c3937d904c07ba93b`; #133 remains OPEN/unmerged at `30ed167ed57e18de0308e7ba1e0c9d0e70ab7570`. This continuation produced research and independently challenged policy proposals only. No runtime/source change, new CI run, credential value access or Production write occurred. These proposals are **PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED**; existing acceptance criteria and gates remain in force.

## Credential reality

Result: PLATFORM_GRANULARITY_LIMIT for the generally documented stable Vercel CLI/PAT model. No documented and verified exact-operation grant was found. This is bounded to supported mechanisms examined; it is not a mathematical claim that no private/custom provider capability exists.

Official sources read 2026-10-05:

- https://vercel.com/docs/accounts/access-tokens — Project scope hard-limits token resources to one project and denies other-project/user/team resources; no per-token verb selector is documented. Personal tokens act on the principal's behalf. Role×scope intersection is a reasonable inference, not a published endpoint-by-endpoint formula.
- https://vercel.com/docs/rbac/access-roles — Developer can manage project deployments/domains and non-production environments; role availability requires Pro/Enterprise. Target plan still requires readback.
- https://vercel.com/docs/rbac/access-roles/extended-permissions — Full Production Deployment enables CLI Production deployment, rollback and promotion of any accessible deployment. It is documented compatible with Team Developer, and included in Member/Owner. Other extended grants must be absent.
- https://vercel.com/docs/rbac/access-roles/project-level-roles — Contributor Project Developer description is not sufficient evidence for CLI Production deploy/promote/restore. Project Admin grants full project/settings control. Public permission matrix rendering is incomplete; no detailed API denial claim is inferred.
- https://vercel.com/docs/rbac/access-groups — Enterprise role assignments can elevate a Developer to project Admin; all direct and group grants must be inspected. Groups do not attenuate the highest effective role.
- https://vercel.com/docs/sign-in-with-vercel/scopes-and-permissions — private-beta resource-level Deployments Read/Write and Projects Read Only are a newly considered research avenue; exact stage/promote/restore endpoint mapping and CLI compatibility remain unverified. This is not a generally supported deploy-only solution or a new documentation publication claim.
- https://vercel.com/docs/integrations/create-integration/vercel-api-integrations — deployment Read/Write category includes broader create/cancel/delete/file operations, not an exact P4 verb grant.

Narrowest documented sufficient candidate for Owner consideration is a Project-scoped PAT for prj_QNMVdxTkPOad4ynN4fwFCYEST8Jk issued to a least-privilege Team Developer with only Full Production Deployment. No Owner/Member/Project Admin/direct or group elevation, and no other extended permissions. Availability on this exact account/plan and actual effective grants are not yet verified. No token was created, requested, read, printed or persisted.

Extra capability is real: project deployment/management; target-project domain management; dev/preview environment management; CLI Production deployment/rollback/promotion of other deployments in this project, not merely the bound artifact. Exact project-settings endpoint rights remain unenumerated. The reviewed workflow confines intended calls; it does not prevent a compromised token-bearing process from exercising additional authorized project capabilities.

Proposed C1 (pending independent challenge and Owner approval): replace the exact-verb-only requirement with exact-project resource scope plus the explicitly approved effective Developer+FullProduction grant manifest and all existing protected workflow controls. No unknown additional grant is automatically included. The Owner must approve the concrete sanitized role/scope/extra-capability manifest for the exact principal/project; if it is unavailable or contains unapproved elevation, stay blocked. Project/team external resource boundary must still be proven, never broadened. This proposal is not implemented and does not verify credential readiness or authorize token creation/Production writes.

## Proposed Owner decision C1

STATUS=PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED
OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED=YES
PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION=NO

## Exact old rule

Accept only a Vercel Production credential proven to allow reads of the exact target project, staged Production deployment, explicit promotion and restoration to an approved retained deployment, while denying every other project-settings, environment-variable, domain, team and other-project write.

## Exact proposed new rule

For the reviewed P4 workflow only, permit a Vercel PAT scoped to exactly `prj_QNMVdxTkPOad4ynN4fwFCYEST8Jk` (`kirari-main`, team `team_NsBZHGUVnyygP7veiROKLuUx`) from a principal whose complete effective grants are Team Developer plus only Full Production Deployment. Verify the target plan supports that model. Reject Owner, Member, direct/group-derived Project Admin or any other extended/elevated grant; reject full-account/team/multi-project token scope.

Before credential use, authenticated read-only evidence must establish the principal identity, actual plan, all direct/group-derived roles and extended grants, exact Project PAT resource scope and expiry. The Owner must separately approve that sanitized, concrete manifest. It must explicitly disclose and accept the Developer+FullProduction capabilities within this one project: deployment/project management, domain management, preview/development environment-variable management, Production branch deployment where enabled, and CLI Production deploy/rollback/promotion of other deployments in the same project. The token is not limited cryptographically to the approved artifact or the workflow's intended operations. Exact project-settings endpoint rights are not exhaustively documented and must be disclosed as unresolved; this proposal requires explicit acceptance of the documented role capability boundary and that endpoint uncertainty, without asserting verb-level denial. Missing role/group/scope/plan/expiry evidence, or new, broader or unapproved effective grants, blocks readiness and cannot be automatically incorporated.

Continue denying all other-project, user-level and team-level resource access through the documented Project token scope. Preserve the dedicated GitHub Environment and exact one `markd3ng` User reviewer, administrator bypass disabled, self-review explicitly allowed, custom `main`-only branch policy, environment-only secret, isolated namespace and exact team/project variables, no Production token/OIDC in prepare/test jobs, persist-credentials false, main-only owner/first-attempt dispatch, replay/nonce/concurrency checks, exact immutable artifact/target/deployment approval, exact GitHub OIDC Trusted Sources, stage→validate→promote ordering, approved-record rollback and post-operation provider/alias/byte/browser readback. Production implementation contains only the reviewed reads, staged prebuilt upload, explicit promote and retained restore calls; no generic settings/env/domain/team write path is permitted.

Trusted Sources actual configuration remains UNKNOWN until authenticated readback and documented semantic interpretation both exist. In particular, do not infer the meaning of `enableVercelCiSameRepository`, instruct the Owner to hand-edit it, or call the current source parser's expected `false` a provider-verified policy. Preserve documented implicit same-project access. An unresolved configuration/semantic mismatch remains a separate readiness blocker.

Use an expiring project token; record its expiry metadata and owner revocation procedure without requesting, printing or retaining its value. Recheck scope/effective grant metadata after role/group/plan changes. A token-scope or role-manifest change invalidates readiness until reviewed again.

## Rationale and residual risk

Current public PAT/CLI documentation exposes resource scope and role capabilities, not an exact P4 verb-only credential. Private-beta Sign in with Vercel resource permissions do not establish supported CLI compatibility or the complete required endpoint matrix. This amendment accepts the platform's documented resource/role granularity explicitly; it does not claim absence of every possible unpublished provider feature.

Project scope limits the external blast radius. Protected admission and reviewed call paths reduce accidental use, but a compromised approved token-bearing process can issue extra authorized writes within this project, including domain/environment changes or promotion of an unapproved deployment. Workflow confinement and Trusted Sources are not an operation-level bearer-token sandbox. If the Owner will not accept that additional capability, retain the old rule and keep P4 blocked; investigate a future documented deploy-only model instead.

Approval of C1 is a policy decision only. It does not create a credential/Environment, verify the actual principal or token, change Trusted Sources, merge #133, emit a Production authorization phrase, or permit any Production write. Actual protected setup and sanitized scope/grant/readback evidence remain mandatory.

## Readiness and exact Owner action checklist

Read-only stream C confirmed `kirari-site-production` GET=404, no Production secret name `VERCEL_PRODUCTION_TOKEN`, and empty existing Production variable lists. Five legacy Production environments have no protection/branch rules and allow admin bypass; none substitutes for the dedicated environment. Repository Actions names remain OCR-only. No credential value was read/requested/persisted.

Vercel projection confirms exact kirari-main/team/project and legacy READY Production dpl_7ACbEGqeC8f7yyqZqmAjzL78F5sB, source 408dff70c5aa7b39cbd3df31103b5847dba9751f. Canonical alias still points there; none of six listed Production deployments uses current main c796. This is read-only provider evidence, not accepted immutable provenance or approved rollback. Project projection omits trustedSources and git; team projection omits plan/roles. These omissions mean UNKNOWN, not empty/verified.

Source `git.deploymentEnabled.main=false` remains PASS. Provider Git setting readback remains UNKNOWN. Workflow retains protected-job-only credential/OIDC, credential-free prepare/tests, persist-credentials false, owner/main/first-attempt gating and exact claims/target checks.

## Minimal Owner actions after policy decisions and separate setup authorization

1. Decide T1 and C1 independently. Neither decision approves a Production operation or automatically verifies a CLI/credential. If rejected, keep the original rule and P4 blocked.
2. For C1, verify plan eligibility and the concrete least-privilege principal: Team Developer plus only Full Production Deployment, no direct/group Admin/Owner/Member or other elevation. Approve sanitized identity, complete effective grants, exact one-project PAT scope, expiry and stated extra capabilities/endpoint uncertainty before use. Configure an expiring PAT through the Owner's secure provider flow; never share the value with the agent. Actual creation/setup remains separately unauthorized in this execution.
3. Create dedicated `kirari-site-production`: exactly one required reviewer `markd3ng`, type User; `can_admins_bypass=false`; `prevent_self_review=false`; custom branch policy permitting only `main`. Add only secret name `VERCEL_PRODUCTION_TOKEN` and the two nonsecret exact-ID variables below.
4. Configure the documented GitHub OIDC source: issuer `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`, audience `https://github.com/markd3ng`, repository `markd3ng/KIRARI`, ref `refs/heads/main`, workflow_ref `markd3ng/KIRARI/.github/workflows/site-production.yml@refs/heads/main`, Production only. No extra providers/repositories/Vercel project callers. Preserve documented implicit self-access. Obtain authenticated raw project GET in memory and authoritative semantics for `enableVercelCiSameRepository`; do not hand-edit an undocumented flag to force parser acceptance. Semantic/readback gaps block readiness until resolved and reviewed.
5. Retain sanitized authenticated target/protection/Git-setting readback. Any rollback operation requires an approved retained release record; the legacy deployment's provenance remains UNKNOWN and it is not such a candidate. The existing deploy binding permits a null rollback record, which means no approved automatic restoration after promotion failure; disclose that concrete recovery limit before any separately authorized first deploy. Reconcile source/parser only when actual documented evidence demonstrates a confirmed defect. No setting writes are authorized here.

## Exact read-only GitHub metadata checks after Owner setup

These print metadata/names or exact-ID match results only; no secret value is accessible through these endpoints.

```sh
gh api repos/markd3ng/KIRARI/environments/kirari-site-production \
  --jq '{name,protection_rules,can_admins_bypass,deployment_branch_policy}'
gh api repos/markd3ng/KIRARI/environments/kirari-site-production/deployment-branch-policies \
  --jq '[.branch_policies[] | {name,type}]'
gh api repos/markd3ng/KIRARI/environments/kirari-site-production/secrets \
  --jq '[.secrets[] | {name,created_at,updated_at}]'
gh api repos/markd3ng/KIRARI/environments/kirari-site-production/variables/VERCEL_PRODUCTION_ORG_ID \
  --jq 'if .value == "team_NsBZHGUVnyygP7veiROKLuUx" then "org_id=MATCH" else "org_id=MISMATCH" end'
gh api repos/markd3ng/KIRARI/environments/kirari-site-production/variables/VERCEL_PRODUCTION_PROJECT_ID \
  --jq 'if .value == "prj_QNMVdxTkPOad4ynN4fwFCYEST8Jk" then "project_id=MATCH" else "project_id=MISMATCH" end'
```

## Exact read-only Vercel procedure

Documented endpoint: `GET https://api.vercel.com/v9/projects/prj_QNMVdxTkPOad4ynN4fwFCYEST8Jk?teamId=team_NsBZHGUVnyygP7veiROKLuUx`.

The Owner may use an already-authenticated local process, keeping its credential only in process memory/environment. Do not print environment, use shell tracing, put Authorization/token into command arguments, serialize raw project response, or enumerate environment variable values. Obtain plan/principal/direct/group/scope/expiry metadata through Owner account controls without revealing the token. Do not perform write-denial tests.

From the reviewed #133 worktree, this example invokes only the exported GET and validators; it does not invoke deployment. It is an unexecuted Owner-local procedure, not evidence of actual readback. A parser match alone is insufficient until the CI boolean semantics are documented/verified. Raw project response may contain environment-shaped fields, so it is never written.

```sh
node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import { getVercelProject, validateVercelProjectIdentity } from './scripts/deploy-vercel-production.mjs';
const target = {
  project: 'kirari-main',
  project_id: 'prj_QNMVdxTkPOad4ynN4fwFCYEST8Jk',
  team_id: 'team_NsBZHGUVnyygP7veiROKLuUx',
  environment: 'production',
  repository: 'markd3ng/KIRARI',
  workflow_path: '.github/workflows/site-production.yml'
};
try {
  if (!process.env.VERCEL_TOKEN) throw new Error('missing local auth');
  const project = await getVercelProject({projectId: target.project_id, teamId: target.team_id, token: process.env.VERCEL_TOKEN});
  validateVercelProjectIdentity(project, target);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({id: project.id, name: project.name, accountId: project.accountId, source_parser_match: true, provider_semantics_verified: false}));
} catch {
  console.error('READBACK_OR_SOURCE_POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED');
  process.exitCode = 1;
}
NODE
```

Any safe normalized Trusted Sources record should contain only enablement flags and expected nonsecret project/OIDC claim configuration after in-memory validation; never retain raw project data. If source parser differs from a documented correct serialization, do not call readiness PASS: report the precise sanitized mismatch and obtain a focused review before changing it.

Sources: https://vercel.com/docs/deployment-protection/methods-to-bypass-deployment-protection/trusted-sources ; https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api/projects/find-a-project-by-id-or-name ; https://vercel.com/docs/rbac/access-roles .

Independent security/contract challenge accepted this as a bounded proposal only; no actual token/plan/effective grants or Trusted Sources were verified. #129 remains OPEN / In Review; #99 remains Blocked. No duplicate Issue or acceptance-criterion change. Neither C1 nor T1 approval is Production authorization.
